race.comment: HARD YARDS (4) improved second-up when out in trip last time, missing by 2.5L on a heavy deck here last time out. Loy remains in the saddle and he's improving nicely. On an upward trajectory and can go one better. HELICONIA (10) gets the blinkers on for the first time coming back to country level and can't be discounted. ROULADEN (7) is better than he showed last time out, coming through a solid provinicial maiden, with that form looking solid for a race like this. Can bounce back to form. MAGIC MOUNTAIN (6) disappointed last time out at this track but his form prior was trending the right way. Finds a suitable race this time around and can put his best foot forward.
